COMPLETE
  ✓ Starter decision records species with the JEV choice distribution and forcing a different choice selects a DIFFERENT species; battle turn logs phase=BATTLE with battle_action from the JEV vocabulary plus raw distribution and no select_move(1) signature: STARTER: cron_runner.py:715-760 `_select_starter_from_menu` now calls `jev_client.decide(state, act_phase=True, questions=jev_client.starter_questions(visible_species=...))` with the species read from the live RAM dialog (`_starter_species_from_dialog`, cron_runner.py:707-711); the decision row records phase=STARTER, starter_choice, visible_species, raw_distribution=decision['raw'], jev_answered (cron_runner.py:752-760) and is written to the run log as `event: starter_selection` / `action: jev_starter_choice` (cron_runner.py:3053-3068). Forcing a different choice selects a DIFFERENT species: STARTER_BALL_X maps CHARMANDER=6/SQUIRTLE=8/BULBASAUR=10 and cron_runner.py:765-800 declines the visible ball with B, walks to target_x, re-confirms, and refuses to confirm if the ground-truth dialog names a different species. Test tests/test_jev4_dehardcoding.py::test_forcing_different_jev_choice_selects_different_starter_species asserts SQUIRTLE != BULBASAUR with different button sequences; the pre-change implementation (dacf0ad~1) had no `decision_out` kwarg and no JEV call, so the test is a genuine RED->GREEN proof, not a tautology. BATTLE: cron_runner.py:1017-1055 `_escalating_recovery` battle branch calls `jev_client.decide(in_battle=True, act_phase=True)`; BATTLE_ACTIONS = {MOVE_1..MOVE_4, SWITCH, ITEM, RUN} (cron_runner.py:930); the decision row records phase=BATTLE, battle_action from that vocabulary, intent, raw_distribution=decision['raw'], jev_answered (cron_runner.py:1030-1046) and is written to the run log as `event: recovery` with **recovery_decision (cron_runner.py:3786-3795). No select_move(1) signature: `_battle_tool_call` derives move_number from the JEV action (cron_runner.py:965), `_battle_action_description` renders select_move(N) (cron_runner.py:984), and the RAM fallback deliberately picks max-PP/later slot to avoid recreating always-move-1 (cron_runner.py:955-957); test_battle_recovery_has_no_select_move_one_signature asserts '{"move_number": 1}' is absent from the source. TEST EVIDENCE: `./venv/bin/pytest tests/test_jev4_dehardcoding.py tests/test_gameplay_escape.py tests/test_full_gameplay.py -q` -> exit_code 0, '39 passed in 3.91s' (JEV-4 file alone: 3 passed). LSP diagnostics: 0 findings. Note: pre-existing select_move(move_number=1) sites remain in src/core/state_window.py:516-525 and src/core/tools.py:405, but those files were not modified by this commit (last touched f31d620) and are outside the A4 recovery path the criterion targets.
JEV-4 is fully implemented: the starter decision is JEV-routed and records the species plus raw distribution (forcing a different choice yields a different species), and the battle turn logs phase=BATTLE with a JEV-vocabulary battle_action plus raw distribution and no select_move(1) signature, with all 39 relevant tests passing.
